1. Overview
EuroMilan is a cross-platform mobile application that gives customers one place to manage their loyalty
balance and stored-value gift cards: sign in, load funds, present a card code at the store, find stores and
products, and manage payment methods, all from an Android or iOS phone.
The app is driven by the server. On start-up it reads the brand’s group configuration (colours, fonts, logo,
language and feature switches), applies any state or age restriction, and then offers sign-in or account
creation. Customer, card, payment and transaction operations are carried out through the Mobile web API
and the Synergy services behind it.
The application was originally written in Xamarin.Forms and has been migrated to .NET MAUI on .NET
10 as a single cross-platform project, keeping the same 36 pages and 38 view-model files and re-using
the existing API, core and entity libraries. Section 5 describes the migration in detail.
2. Business Context
Brands that run loyalty and stored-value gift card programmes typically need to:
• Give customers one place to see their loyalty points and gift card balances
• Let customers reload a gift card and pay from it in store using a scannable code
• Accept several ways to fund a card: credit card, bank (ACH), crypto currency and partner payments
• Offer promotions and promo codes, and let customers share access through authorized users
• Help customers find participating stores and browse the product catalogue

• Keep the app on-brand, in the customer’s language and inside regional restrictions, without a new
release for every change
EuroMilan brings these needs into a single branded mobile app, backed by a shared services platform
that controls appearance, language and features per brand.

4. Functional Modules
4.1 Account Creation & Secure Login

• New customers register with name, email, phone (with a country-code picker) and password, then
confirm a validation code before completing the account

• Returning customers sign in with email or phone and password; Face ID or fingerprint sign-in is
offered when the device supports it

• Saved sign-in values are AES-256 encrypted, and Logout clears them; forgot-password and change-
password flows are provided
4.2 Loyalty & Gift Card Wallet

• A home screen presents the customer’s loyalty balance and gift cards, with separate Pay with Gift
Card and Pay with Loyalty screens

• Each card can be shown as a QR code for scanning at the store, with its transaction history and
balance

• Cards can be added by number, including virtual cards, and a gift card can be added to Google Wallet
(Android) or exported as an Apple Wallet pass (iOS)
4.3 Load Funds & Payment Methods

• A gift card is loaded with a saved credit card or bank (ACH) account; payment methods are added,
activated and set as default from My Payments

• Crypto loading shows the exchange rate, amount and address to pay, and the card is loaded once the
payment is received

• A ColumbiaCare payment option is available when the brand enables it, and billing addresses are
managed alongside payment methods
4.4 Auto Load, Promotions & Transfers

• Auto Load settings reload a card by a chosen amount when its balance falls below a set threshold,
using a saved payment method
• Promo codes can be entered or applied from the Promotions menu to load value onto a card
• Transfer Balance moves the balance from one card to another

4.5 Store Locator & Product Catalog
• Stores are listed using the customer’s location, with a store details page showing a map pin
• Directions to a store are drawn on the map using Google Maps services
• A Products page lists the brand’s products with their images
4.6 Authorized Users & Profile Management
• Account owners can add authorized users and review the list of users with access
• Profile details and dynamic fields can be updated, and passwords changed
• A customer can delete their account from the profile screen
4.7 Notifications & Engagement

• Push notifications are handled by the OneSignal SDK on Android and iOS, with the notification
permission requested at start-up
• The device identifier is captured through a platform service on each operating system

• The Inbox screen is in place; its message list was tied to the previous push provider and is still to be
reconnected
4.8 Branding, Localization & Support

• Colours, fonts, corner radius, logo size, banner and footer settings come from the brand’s group
configuration and are applied at start-up

• The interface is localized through resource files in English and Spanish (Mexico), selected by the
brand’s language setting

• Contact Us, About, How It Works and Legal pages complete the support content; location and age
checks can block or gate access

7. System Architecture & Integrations
The solution contains the mobile app, shared libraries and the server-side APIs:

• Mobile app: MobileEuroMilanMaui, a single .NET MAUI project with XAML pages, MVVM view
models, converters, behaviors and a Shell flyout menu

• Shared libraries: Mobile.App.Api (service clients and HTTP helper), Mobile.App.Core (validation
helpers), Mobile.App.Entities (request and response models), Mobile.App.Logging and KAM.Core

• Web APIs: Mobile.App.Auth.WebApi issues JWT tokens and serves group, validation-code and
customer endpoints; Mobile.App.WebApi serves group information

• Data layer: Mobile.App.Data uses Entity Framework Core on SQL Server (SynergyAdmin and
MobileApp databases) for customers, cards, payments, reloads, promo codes and authorized users

• Payment and partner services: ForumPay for crypto loading, ColumbiaCare for partner payments,
Google Pay and Apple Wallet pass generation

• Platform services: Google Maps geocoding, directions and place search; OneSignal for push; email
and SMS helpers in KAM.Core

9. Security & Data Handling

• The Auth Web API issues JWT bearer tokens (issuer and audience validation, signing key, lifetime
checks) with refresh-token support and an admin-only impersonation endpoint

• Customer credentials are validated against the Synergy customer records; new accounts and
password resets are confirmed with validation codes

• Saved email, phone and password values on the device are AES-256 encrypted, and Logout clears
the stored values
• Face ID and fingerprint sign-in is optional and depends on device support
• Location and age checks can restrict access by state or require an age confirmation before sign-in

• Payment card and bank details are entered in the app and sent to the server; card numbers are
validated on the client
• Android release builds are signed with a keystore and packaged as an app bundle
10. Value Delivered
• Gives customers a single, unified wallet for loyalty rewards and stored value
• Removes the need for a physical card by presenting scannable codes and wallet passes
• Increases card usage through flexible loading: card, ACH, crypto, auto load and promo codes
• Lets each brand control look, language and features from the server, without a new app release

• Modernizes the mobile codebase by migrating from Xamarin.Forms to .NET MAUI on .NET 10,
preserving the existing backend services and business logic
• Extends account flexibility with authorized users and balance transfers
• Improves reach and engagement with store discovery and push notifications
